# Load data

```{r}
esviritu_res <- fread(here("data", "Esviritu_HostDiseaseGenometypeV1.tsv"))
esviritu_res_human <- esviritu_res[esviritu_res$host_species == "Homo sapiens", ]

esviritu_res_non_human <- esviritu_res[esviritu_res$host_species != "Homo sapiens", ]

sample_metadata <- read.csv(here("data", "samples_metadata.csv"), sep=";", dec=",")
```

# Format the input data
```{r per-sample-taxa-level-RPKMF-df}
RPKMF_df <- function(data, tax_level){
  RPKMF_df <- data %>%
    group_by(sample_id, !!sym(tax_level)) %>%
    summarize(RPKMF = sum(true_rpkmf)) %>%  #HUOM MUUTETTU TULOSTEN AJON JÄLKEEN
    ungroup()
  
  RPKMF_df_wide <-pivot_wider(data=RPKMF_df,
                    names_from = sample_id,
                    values_from = RPKMF,
                    values_fill = list(RPKMF=0))

  return(t(RPKMF_df_wide))
}
```

Taxa level specific abundance dataframe - features as columns, samples as rows
```{r}
maaslin_in <- function(data, taxa_level){
  RPKMF_df_taxa <- RPKMF_df(data, taxa_level)
  colnames(RPKMF_df_taxa) <- RPKMF_df_taxa[1,]

  RPKMF_df_taxa <- RPKMF_df_taxa[-1, ]

  maaslin_in_abund <- matrix(as.numeric(RPKMF_df_taxa), 
                         nrow = nrow(RPKMF_df_taxa), 
                         ncol = ncol(RPKMF_df_taxa))

  # Convert numeric matrix to data frame
  maaslin_in_abund <- as.data.frame(maaslin_in_abund)

  # Preserve row and column names (if they exist)
  rownames(maaslin_in_abund) <- rownames(RPKMF_df_taxa)
  colnames(maaslin_in_abund) <- colnames(RPKMF_df_taxa)
  
  return(maaslin_in_abund)

}

maaslin_in_hspecies <- maaslin_in(esviritu_res_human, "species")

maaslin_in_non_hspecies <- maaslin_in(esviritu_res_non_human, "species")
#check that the input data looks right
#typeof(maaslin_in_hspecies)
#class(maaslin_in_hspecies)
#str(maaslin_in_hspecies)
maaslin_in_hspecies[1:5,1:5]
```

Format the input metadata file

```{r}
maaslin_in_meta <- sample_metadata[,c("sample_ID", "Year",  "reads_in_sample")]
maaslin_in_meta$reads_in_sample <- as.numeric(maaslin_in_meta$reads_in_sample)
rownames(maaslin_in_meta) <- maaslin_in_meta$sample_ID

maaslin_in_meta <- as.data.frame(maaslin_in_meta[,-1])
maaslin_in_meta$reads_in_sample <- as.integer(maaslin_in_meta$reads_in_sample)

#make years 2020-2021 and 2024-2025 a categorical variable
maaslin_in_meta$Year_cat <- ifelse(maaslin_in_meta$Year == "2020" | 
                                     maaslin_in_meta$Year == "2021", 
                                   "2020-2021", "2024-2025")

#typeof(maaslin_in_meta)
#class(maaslin_in_meta)
#str(maaslin_in_meta)
maaslin_in_meta
```

Test difference between years
No maaslin_comparison pairwise test needed with two groups

```{r HUMAN-VIRUSES}
set.seed(2025)

filt2.5_prev_H0_0 <- maaslin3(input_data = maaslin_in_hspecies,
                        input_metadata = maaslin_in_meta,
                        output = 'MaAsLin3_filt2.5_human_years_prevH0_0',
                        formula = '~ Year_cat + reads_in_sample',
                        normalization = 'TSS',
                        transform = 'LOG',
                        #filter out species detected in less than 2.5% of samples
                        min_prevalence = 3/120, 
                        min_abundance = 0,
                        augment = TRUE,
                        standardize = TRUE,
                        max_significance = 0.1,
                        plot_associations = TRUE,
                        plot_summary_plot = TRUE,
                        median_comparison_abundance = TRUE,
                        median_comparison_prevalence = FALSE,
                        cores = 3)

filt2.5_prev_H0_med <- maaslin3(input_data = maaslin_in_hspecies,
                        input_metadata = maaslin_in_meta,
                        output = 'MaAsLin3_filt2.5_human_years_prevH0_med',
                        formula = '~ Year_cat + reads_in_sample',
                        normalization = 'TSS',
                        transform = 'LOG',
                        #filter out species detected in less than 2.5% of samples
                        min_prevalence = 3/120,
                        min_abundance = 0,
                        augment = TRUE,
                        standardize = TRUE,
                        max_significance = 0.1,
                        plot_associations = TRUE,
                        plot_summary_plot = TRUE,
                        median_comparison_abundance = TRUE,
                        median_comparison_prevalence = TRUE,
                        cores = 3)
```

## Plot volcano plots from the significant results

```{r}
plot_volcano <- function(data){
  #filter out results with errors, only keep ones without
  #and only features significant by year comparison (no reads in sample)
  plot_data <- data[is.na(data$error), ] %>%
    filter(metadata=="Year_cat")
  
  plot_data$logqval <- -log10(plot_data$qval_individual)
  #make qval=0 values plotting possible
  plot_data$logqval[is.infinite(plot_data$logqval)] <- max(plot_data$logqval[is.finite(plot_data$logqval)], na.rm = TRUE) + 1
  #categorize results based on significance
  plot_data <- plot_data %>%
  mutate(signif = case_when(
    coef > 0 & qval_individual < 0.05 ~ "positive",
    coef < 0 & qval_individual < 0.05 ~ "negative",
    TRUE ~ "not_significant"
  ))
  
  #clean the feature names, remove "s__"
  plot_data$feature <- gsub("s__", "", plot_data$feature)
  
  #return(plot_data)
  volcano_plot <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = coef, y = logqval)) +
     geom_point(aes(color = signif), size=1) +
     theme_bw() +
     labs(x = "Effect Size (log2FC)",
          y = "-log10(q-value)") +
     scale_color_manual(labels = c("positive"="Positive", "negative"="Negative", "not_significant"="Not significant"),
       values = c("positive"="#B23539","negative"="#514289", "not_significant"="grey"),
       names("Significance"))+
    theme(legend.position = "right") +
     scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.1)))
  
  return(volcano_plot)
}
```

## Plot heatmap of the significant results

```{r}
plot_heatmap <- function(data, original_data, test){
  #filter out results with errors, only keep ones without
  #keep only results associated with year comparison
  signif_features <- data[is.na(data$error), ] %>%
    filter(metadata=="Year_cat")
  
  #keep only the significant ones 
  #filter only based on q-value (adjusted p-value)
  #later by effect size?
  signif_features <- signif_features %>%
    filter(qval_individual < 0.05)
  
  #get the names of significant features, subset the original data based on that
  plot_data <- t(original_data[colnames(original_data) %in% signif_features$feature])
  rownames(plot_data) <- sub("s__", "", rownames(plot_data))
  pal <- park_palette("DeathValley")
  pal2 <- park_palette("ArcticGates")
  #column annotations
  annot_col <- data.frame(Year = c(rep("2020/2021", 60), rep("2024/2025", 60)))
  rownames(annot_col) <- colnames(plot_data)
  annot_colors <- list(Year = c("2020/2021" = pal[6], "2024/2025" = pal[1]))

  main_title = ifelse(test=="a", "Differentially abundant species",
                "Differentially prevalent species")
  print(main_title)
  #plot heatmap
  pal <- colorRampPalette(c(pal[6], "white", pal[1]))(100)
  
  plot <- pheatmap(log2(plot_data+1),
           color = pal,
           cluster_rows = TRUE,
           cluster_cols = FALSE,
           show_colnames = FALSE,
           scale = "row",
           annotation_col = annot_col,
           annotation_colors = annot_colors,
           breaks = seq(-2, 2, length.out = 101),
           main = main_title)

  return(plot)
  
}
```

```{r}
p1 <- plot_heatmap(filt2.5_prev_H0_0$fit_data_abundance$results, 
                              maaslin_in_hspecies, "a")
ggsave(p1,

       width = 10, height = 4, units = "in", dpi=300)
```
